sections.shortTitle: Martial Law Order 1962 Zone B No 9-F
sections.section: ORDER - Martial Law Order 1962 (Zone B) No. 9-F
sections.description:
MARTIAL LAW REGULATION
MARTIAL LAW REGULATION
By
MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATOR, ZONE `B'
No. 9-F
[13th January 1962, Gazette
of West Pakistan,
Extraordinary, 16th
January 1962]
The
following amendments are made and shall be deemed to have been made to Martial
Law Regulation, Zone `B' No. 9, with effect from 17th March 1959:
In
the said Regulation :
1.
(a) In Schedule 1,
in paragraph (4) after the words "General Head-quarters"
full stop shall be substituted by a comma and the following words added,
"Naval Headquarters and Air Headquarters."
(b)
For paragraph (6) the following shall be substituted, namely
:
"Commissioned
Officers of the Armed Forces approved and recommended by General Headquarters, Naval Headquarters and Air Headquarters, for
providing leadership."
2.
In Schedule II after paragraph
(2) for the heading "Army Officers" the heading "Commissioned
Officers of the Armed Forces" shall be substituted.
